methodology.instrument: 30-year semiannual fixed bond, face 100, 41 coupons from 2% to 6%
methodology.reference: sum(amount * exp(-0.05 * actual_days / 365)) on Convex-generated future cashflows
methodology.timing: in-process warm calls; microseconds; no FFI or serialization
methodology.parallel: explicit Rayon adapters around scalar OSS functions; fixed 1/4 threads
methodology.excluded: compilation, input construction, cashflow conversion, dependency graph, service transport
methodology.batch_output: all timings materialize instrument PV vectors and aggregate a checksum
methodology.callable_timing: stochastic-rs reuses a built tree; Convex builds a curve-fitted tree in each call; not comparable models/timings
methodology.convex_product_exception: product pricing regenerates cashflows inside the timed call
methodology.python_existing: base discounting is precomputed in A, as required by corp_pv; OAS exp is timed
methodology.custom_controls: custom fused Rust/Numba loops are controls, not OSS implementations
methodology.memory: Python prepared input bytes only; not process peak memory
